meta.title: Veilus — Anti-detect browser with built-in automation
meta.description: Run many accounts on one computer, each with its own fingerprint and proxy. Have your AI assistant write the script over MCP, or write it yourself, then run it on every profile. Free for 5 profiles.

features.title: Everything you need,
features.subtitle: The anti-detect browser and the automation live in the same place.

items.title: Each profile looks like a different person
items.desc: Every profile gets its own fingerprint and its own HTTP, HTTPS or SOCKS5 proxy. Profiles run on a Chromium engine that Veilus builds and patches in-house.

items.title: Write it once, run it everywhere
items.desc: Ask your AI assistant to write the script — over MCP it tries the script on a few profiles, reads each profile's errors and fixes them. Or write it yourself. Veilus Flow then runs it on as many profiles as you choose.

items.title: Work runs while you're away
items.desc: Put scripts on a schedule, or run them as a batch over many profiles at once.

items.title: Connect your own tools
items.desc: A local REST API and MCP let your own code and AI tools open profiles and run automation.

items.title: Take your setup with you
items.desc: Veilus Sync keeps profiles in sync through a Git repository or Google Drive you choose. Start scripts from templates, and import or export profiles when you change machines.

faq.title: Frequently
faq.subtitle: What people ask before they download.

items.a: No tool can promise that, and we don't. Each profile runs on Veilus's own patched Chromium build with its own fingerprint and proxy, and we test profiles with creepjs and iphey. How your accounts are treated also depends on how you use them.

items.q: Is it really free? Do I need a card?
items.a: Yes. The Free plan gives you 5 profiles on 1 device, with no time limit and no card. Veilus Flow, schedules, batch runs and the local API/MCP need Pro.

items.q: How does the 7-day Pro trial work?
items.a: Request it in the app with your email. We send you a key by email; paste it into the app to unlock Pro. After 7 days you drop back to Free and keep your profiles.

items.q: Which operating systems does it run on?
items.a: macOS and Windows. There is no Linux version.

Profile data is stored locally on your machine. If you turn on Veilus Sync, profiles sync to a Git repository or Google Drive you choose — use a private one. When you export a profile to a .veiluspack file, you can set a password to encrypt the file.

items.q: Can I use my own proxies?
items.a: Yes. HTTP, HTTPS and SOCKS5 are supported, and each profile can have its own proxy.

Connect an AI assistant that supports MCP, such as Claude Code or Cursor, and give it a task. It writes a Playwright script, runs it on a few profiles, reads each profile's errors and fixes them. You can also write the script yourself and add it through the local REST API. Scripts added over MCP or REST run on at most 3 profiles per run until you approve them in Veilus Flow; after that, run them as a batch or put them on a schedule. Veilus Flow is part of Pro.

items.q: How is Veilus different from other anti-detect browsers?
items.a: Automation is built in: your AI assistant writes and fixes scripts over MCP, or you write them yourself, and Veilus runs them across profiles, with schedules, batch runs and a local REST API in the same app. You can also pay once for a lifetime license instead of a subscription.
Yes. Monthly payments can be refunded within 7 days, lifetime licenses within 14 days.
